lesson: gzip copies the SOURCE file's mtime onto the compressed output. A .gz whose mtime predates your session is NOT evidence of corruption or a stalled job — check process, payload size (gzip -l), and CRC (gzip -t) before declaring failure. Forensic cost when unknown: 3 tool calls.
evidence: 2026-09-04: opencode-db-pre-purge .gz showed mtime Aug 24 + vanished process mid-verify; gzip -t OK, gzip -l = exact 6014107648B payload. Documented gzip behavior (mode+timestamps copied from input).
